question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a black ball, Bob has a gold ball, Claire has a silver ball, Dave has a teal ball, Eve has a yellow ball, Fred has a grey ball, and Gertrude has a brown ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Eve and Fred swap balls. Then, Claire and Bob swap balls. Then, Alice and Eve swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Eve and Claire swap balls. Then, Fred and Dave swap balls. Finally, Gertrude and Eve swap balls. At the end of the game, Gertrude has the
Options:
(A) black ball
(B) gold ball
(C) silver ball
(D) teal ball
(E) yellow ball
(F) grey ball
(G) brown ball
solution:
Read each row as the ball colors held by Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: black, gold, silver, teal, yellow, grey, brown
1. Eve ↔ Fred: black, gold, silver, teal, grey, yellow, brown
2. Claire ↔ Bob: black, silver, gold, teal, grey, yellow, brown
3. Alice ↔ Eve: grey, silver, gold, teal, black, yellow, brown
4. Claire ↔ Eve: grey, silver, black, teal, gold, yellow, brown
5. Eve ↔ Claire: grey, silver, gold, teal, black, yellow, brown
6. Fred ↔ Dave: grey, silver, gold, yellow, black, teal, brown
7. Gertrude ↔ Eve: grey, silver, gold, yellow, brown, teal, black
Gertrude holds the black ball (seventh entry), option (A).
Final answer: (A)
